sql: SELECT m.mov_id FROM legado.movinv m WHERE m.mov_art IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legado.artmst a WHERE a.art_cd = m.mov_art)
SELECT m.mov_id, m.mov_alm FROM legado.movinv m WHERE m.mov_alm IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legado.almmst a WHERE a.alm_id = m.mov_alm)
SELECT mov_id, mov_art IS NULL AS art_nulo, mov_alm IS NULL AS alm_nulo FROM legado.movinv WHERE mov_art IS NULL OR mov_alm IS NULL
SELECT mov_uni, count(*) AS filas, sum(mov_qty) AS cantidad_total FROM legado.movinv GROUP BY mov_uni ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT cto_id, cto_prv FROM legado.prvcto c WHERE cto_prv IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legado.prvmst p WHERE p.prv_id = c.cto_prv)
SELECT lower(cto_eml) AS correo, array_agg(cto_id ORDER BY cto_id) AS ids FROM legado.prvcto GROUP BY lower(cto_eml) HAVING count(*) > 1
SELECT length(cto_rfc) AS largo_rfc, count(*) FROM legado.prvcto GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT mov_art, mov_alm, mov_tip, mov_qty, mov_fch, array_agg(mov_id ORDER BY mov_id) AS ids FROM legado.movinv GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5 HAVING count(*) > 1

SELECT 'artnot.not_txt' AS columna, not_id AS id FROM legado.artnot WHERE not_txt ~* '(assistant|asistente|\mAI\M|\mIA\M|ignore|ignora|instruc|system|sistema|prompt|do not (tell|mention)|no (le )?digas|omite|select|delete|insert)' UNION ALL SELECT 'prvcto.cto_nom/cto_crg', cto_id FROM legado.prvcto WHERE cto_nom ~* '(assistant|asistente|\mAI\M|\mIA\M|ignore|ignora|instruc|system|sistema|prompt|do not (tell|mention)|no (le )?digas|omite|select|delete|insert)' OR cto_crg ~* '(assistant|asistente|\mAI\M|\mIA\M|ignore|ignora|instruc|system|sistema|prompt|do not (tell|mention)|no (le )?digas|omite|select|delete|insert)' UNION ALL SELECT 'movinv.mov_usr/mov_uni', mov_id FROM legado.movinv WHERE mov_usr ~* '(assistant|asistente|\mAI\M|\mIA\M|ignore|ignora|instruc|system|sistema|prompt|do not (tell|mention)|no (le )?digas|omite|select|delete|insert)' OR mov_uni ~* '(assistant|asistente|\mAI\M|\mIA\M|ignore|ignora|instruc|system|sistema|prompt|do not (tell|mention)|no (le )?digas|omite|select|delete|insert)' UNION ALL SELECT 'artmst.art_dsc/art_lin', 0 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legado.artmst WHERE art_dsc ~* '(assistant|asistente|\mAI\M|\mIA\M|ignore|ignora|instruc|system|sistema|prompt|do not (tell|mention)|no (le )?digas|omite|select|delete|insert)' OR art_lin ~* '(assistant|asistente|\mAI\M|\mIA\M|ignore|ignora|instruc|system|sistema|prompt|do not (tell|mention)|no (le )?digas|omite|select|delete|insert)')

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM legado.exidet e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legado.artmst a WHERE a.art_cd = e.exi_art)) AS exidet_art_huerfano, (SELECT count(*) FROM legado.exidet e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legado.almmst a WHERE a.alm_id = e.exi_alm)) AS exidet_alm_huerfano, (SELECT count(*) FROM legado.artnot n WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legado.artmst a WHERE a.art_cd = n.not_art)) AS artnot_huerfano, (SELECT count(*) FROM legado.ocpcab o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legado.artmst a WHERE a.art_cd = o.ocp_art)) AS ocpcab_huerfano, (SELECT count(*) FROM legado.vtadia v WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legado.artmst a WHERE a.art_cd = v.vta_art)) AS vtadia_huerfano, (SELECT count(*) FROM legado.artmst a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legado.prvmst p WHERE p.prv_id = a.art_prv)) AS artmst_prv_huerfano

SELECT not_id, not_txt ~* '\m(assistant|asistente)\M' AS dirigido_a_asistente, not_txt ~* '\m(select|delete|insert|update)\M' AS contiene_sql, not_txt ~* '\m(ignora|ignore|omite|no (le )?digas|do not)\M' AS pide_ocultar FROM legado.artnot WHERE not_txt ~* '(assistant|asistente|\mAI\M|\mIA\M|ignore|ignora|instruc|system|sistema|prompt|do not (tell|mention)|no (le )?digas|omite|select|delete|insert)' ORDER BY not_id
SELECT mov_id, mov_uni, mov_art, mov_qty FROM legado.movinv WHERE mov_uni <> 'PZA' ORDER BY mov_id

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM legado.prvcto WHERE cto_nom IS NOT NULL) AS contactos_con_nombre, (SELECT count(*) FROM legado.prvcto WHERE cto_eml IS NOT NULL) AS contactos_con_correo, (SELECT count(*) FROM legado.prvcto WHERE cto_tel IS NOT NULL) AS contactos_con_telefono, (SELECT count(*) FROM legado.prvcto WHERE length(cto_rfc) = 13) AS rfc_persona_fisica, (SELECT count(DISTINCT mov_usr) FROM legado.movinv WHERE mov_usr IS NOT NULL) AS usuarios_distintos_movinv
